enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Stretch legs. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing, and using the bathroom
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Place pan on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat eggs. Drink milk.

enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Close wardrobe. Open drawer. Take out pants. Close drawer. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Tie shoelaces. Pick up bag. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing leisure activities, such as watching TV or reading

enriched_activities.activity: Bedtime routine, reading or watching TV in bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Change into pajamas. Get into bed. Pick up book. Read. Turn page. Put down book. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Turn off light. Lie down. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Stretch arms. Sleep.
